name: Imabetsu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Imabetsu town emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing three vertical bars.
history: Municipal flag of Imabetsu, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 December 1965.

features.role: Imabetsu town emblem — a broken ring enclosing three vertical bars
